One-time pay-to-download pricing (Basic = transparent PNG + vector; Pro = high-res; Brand = full kit), no refunds (one-time 30-day replacement only). Use when generating a logo or brand kit in LogoAI, choosing which package to buy, what's free to preview vs paid to download, a still-charged-after-canceling billing issue, or whether LogoAI has an API — its 'Logo API'/White Label is an iframe reseller program (a four-figure setup + 40% revenue share, gated behind 50 affiliate referrals), NOT a self-serve API. Do NOT use to generate the business name itself (use /sales-namelix), compare branding tools or validate the idea first (use /sales-idea-validation), or build wider marketing creative (use /sales-canva).
